Kanban BLOGREPORT-0111. Built real, reusable CLI support that didn't exist before -- emily blog post (new iduna.Client.PostBlog + cmd/blog.go), mirroring PostPromptOVerseNode's own pattern, POSTing to IDUNA's existing /api/v1/blog/posts. Then used it for real: pulled the actual last-12-hours completion Apples via emily apples list -since 720 -t completion (67 raw, 53 unique after deduping the changelog-sibling pairs), and published a real, detailed 1500-word report grouped by thread (PARENA protocol work, BURROW Go-emission parity, BRAWLPIT tuning, WOTAN hat store Phase 0-1, GFD dungeons Milestones 1-3, the matchmaker incident, Principle 19) rather than a generic summary. Live at https://okemily.com/blog/twelve-hours-fifty-three-tickets/ (confirmed 200). emily.cli commit f5907a3. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e

⚓ ☃
title: BLOGREPORT-0111: shipped emily blog post CLI command, published real 12-hour/53-ticket report
